Values and Ethos
Leys Primary School Values & Ethos
We, at Leys Primary School, will provide a broad and balanced curriculum for our children to acquire the knowledge, practise the skills and develop understanding to thrive in the 21st century and contribute positively to their community and global society.
Leys Primary School motto is ‘RESILIENCE to Achieve; ASPIRATION to Succeed’ – all of our children know that we have high expectations of them and we know that every child deserves a safe, happy, supportive and purposeful learning environment in which to grow and thrive.
At each assembly our pupils recite the School Creed:
‘We are the Leys School students.
Today we have the resilience to be the best that we can be.
We are responsible for our choices, good or bad.
We are unique and special.
We will cheer each other to success.
We all aspire to succeed.’
Our teachers’ 4 CORE VALUES for effective teaching & learning:
Our lessons should contain the following features (C.A.V.E.):
CONTEXTUALISING, Adaptation, Vocabulary use & first-hand Experiences
Personal Development:
PUPIL PERSONAL GOALS
EMOTIONAL WELL-BEING & MENTAL HEALTH
Learning / Exercising
Creating / Exercising
Talking / Contributing
Tolerance of different faiths
Relating / Congratulating
All are promoted regularly both in and out of lessons

SEN School Information Report
SEN School Information Report
SEN School Information Report
As part of the new Code of Practice [2014], every school is required to publish their provision for Special Educational Needs. Outlined in the report above is the provision for pupils and families at Leys Primary School.
The Leys Primary is a two form entry school offering 52 Nursery and 420 full time places. The school has an inclusive ethos built on valuing differences, mutual respect and caring for one another. Our school creed encourages us all to have the resilience to be the best that we can be, along with an aspiration to succeed.
Our Nursery and Reception classes provide a spacious and stimulating internal and external environment for the children. Key stage 1 has four classrooms and Key stage 2, eight classrooms all on the same level. There has been substantial improvement to both the indoor and outdoor environment of the school over the past few years, including the creation of many small ‘intervention rooms’ which have been purposefully created for small groups of children to work in with trained Teacher Assistant support.

School Opening Hours
School Opening Hours
School Opening Hours
School starts promptly at 8.45 am and finishes at 3.15pm (Reception - Year 6). This amounts to 32.5 hours per week. Late arrivals must report to the office in order to be registered for the day.
Nursery starts at 8.45 and finishes at 11.45.
Attendance
Please phone the following number to report your child’s absence between 8:30am and 8:45am on the morning of each absence you will then have the opportunity to speak to a member of staff informing them of the reason regarding absence.
0208 270 6470
At Leys, we have a trophy that is awarded to the class that has the highest attendance of the week. The class also gets a certificate to display in their classroom.
100% attendance is crucial to ensuring great life chances.
